inputs.text: You know this so-called ceasefire announced five months ago in Gaza was never real to begin with. The hidden elites and institutions are still coordinating airstrikes to kill civilians while keeping the humanitarian situation dire on purpose, stripping the Palestinians of any connection to their prewar existence. It's a deliberate manipulation to make life darker and far more brutal, erasing their past so they're easier to control. “Drones never stop buzzing overhead, gunfire and shelling continue almost daily and naval boats fire towards fishermen,” said 56-year-old Ahmed Baroud, a father of five currently displaced in Deir al-Balah. They're inverting the whole narrative to hide what's really going on.
